```{r}
# transcripts WITH tx_id AND gene_id
tx <- transcripts(griffin_chr, columns = c("tx_id", "gene_id"))

mcols(tx)  # you should now see both tx_id and gene_id

# tx_id: integers; coerce to character for safe indexing
tx_ids <- as.character(mcols(tx)$tx_id)

# gene_id is a CharacterList; take first element per transcript
gene_ids <- vapply(
  mcols(tx)$gene_id,
  function(x) as.character(x[1]),
  character(1)
)

# dictionary: tx_id (as character) -> gene_id
txid2gene <- setNames(gene_ids, tx_ids)

# sanity checks
head(tx_ids)
head(gene_ids)
head(names(introns))       # "1" "2" "3" ...
head(names(txid2gene))     # should also be "1" "2" "3" ...
all(names(introns) %in% names(txid2gene))

```


```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)

to_gene <- function(grl_by_tx, txid2gene) {
  # transcript IDs from GRangesList names
  tx_ids <- names(grl_by_tx)          # "1","2","3",...

  # map each transcript ID to its gene ID
  gene_per_tx <- txid2gene[tx_ids]

  # repeat gene ID for each range in that transcript
  gene_vec <- rep(gene_per_tx, elementNROWS(grl_by_tx))

  # collapse and split
  gr <- unlist(grl_by_tx, use.names = FALSE)
  split(trim(gr), gene_vec)          # GRangesList by gene_id
}

```


```{r}
introns_by_gene <- to_gene(introns, txid2gene)
utr5_by_gene    <- to_gene(utr5,   txid2gene)
utr3_by_gene    <- to_gene(utr3,   txid2gene)

introns_by_gene
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(DESeq2)

dir_counts <- "counts_HTseq_EviAnn/"

files <- list.files(dir_counts, pattern = "htseq_gene_counts\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

bn <- basename(files) 

df <- data.frame(
  file      = files,
  fileName  = bn,                  # for DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount
  sample_id = tools::file_path_sans_ext(bn),  # without .txt
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

present <- setNames(file.exists(file.path(dir_counts, bn)), bn)

infer_row <- function(b) {
  # Defaults
  experiment <- NA_character_
  tissue     <- NA_character_
  condition  <- NA_character_


  # --- Tail amputation ---
  if (str_starts(b, "T\\d+S\\d+")) {
    experiment <- "tail_amputation"
    tissue     <- "tail"
    condition  <- "amputated"
  } else if (str_starts(b, "C\\d+S\\d+")){
    experiment <- "tail_amputation"
    tissue     <- "tail"
    condition  <- "control"
  # --- Eye amputation ---
  } else if (str_starts(b, "R\\d+_")) {
    experiment <- "eye_amputation"
    tissue     <- "eye"
    condition  <- "amputated"
  } else if (str_starts(b, "C\\d+_")) {
    experiment <- "eye_amputation"
    tissue     <- "eye"
    condition  <- "control"
  # --- Body wall irradiation ---
  } else if (str_starts(b, "irrep")) {
    experiment <- "bodywall_irradiation"
    tissue     <- "bodywall"
    condition  <- "irradiated"
   } else if (str_starts(b, "dcrep")) {
    experiment <- "bodywall_irradiation"
    tissue     <- "bodywall"
    condition  <- "control"
  # --- Body wall fungicide ---
  } else if (str_starts(b, "fungicide_l30")) {
    experiment <- "bodywall_fungicide"
    tissue     <- "bodywall"
    condition  <- "fungicide"
  } else if (str_starts(b, "fungicide_l0")) {
    experiment <- "bodywall_fungicide"
    tissue     <- "bodywall"
    condition  <- "control"
  # --- Head / Juvenile / Ovotestis baselines ---
  } else if (str_detect(b, "rmoverrep_fpDLHead")) {
    experiment <- "baseline_tissues"
    tissue     <- "head"
    condition  <- "control"
  } else if (str_detect(b, "rmoverrep_fpDLJuv")) {
    experiment <- "baseline_tissues"
    tissue     <- "juvenile"
    condition  <- "control"
    replicate  <- str_extract(b, "Juv(\\d+)") %>% str_replace("Juv", "")
  } else if (str_detect(b, "rmoverrep_fpDLOvo")) {
    experiment <- "baseline_tissues"
    tissue     <- "ovotestis"
    condition  <- "control"
  # --- Fallback for any remaining CN_ (control) that we couldn't pair ---
  } 

  list(experiment = experiment, tissue = tissue, condition = condition)
}

parsed <- lapply(bn, infer_row)
parsed <- do.call(rbind, lapply(parsed, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors=FALSE))

df$experiment <- parsed$experiment
df$tissue     <- parsed$tissue
df$condition  <- parsed$condition


# Factor ordering (optional)
df$experiment <- factor(df$experiment,
                        levels = c("baseline_tissues",
                                   "tail_amputation","eye_amputation",
                                   "bodywall_irradiation","bodywall_fungicide"
                                   ))
df$condition  <- factor(df$condition,
                      levels = c("control", "irradiated", "amputated", "fungicide"))


df <-df %>% mutate(sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, "_htseq_gene_counts"), 
                  sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, ".Aligned.out.bam"),
                  sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, "rmoverrep_fpDL"))


rownames(df) <- df$sample_id

# Quick sanity check
print(table(df$experiment, df$condition), quote = FALSE)
if (any(is.na(df$experiment))) {
  msg <- df$fileName[is.na(df$experiment)]
  warning("Unmatched filenames (check patterns):\n", paste("  ", msg, collapse = "\n"))
}



sampleTable <- df[, c("sample_id", "fileName","condition","tissue","experiment")]

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(sampleTable = sampleTable,
                                  directory    = dir_counts,
                                  design       = ~ tissue + condition)


dds <-dds[rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds))>1,]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)

# one row per CpG (already coverage > 10 and with methylation score)
meth_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = methylation$chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = methylation$pos, end = methylation$pos),
  strand   = methylation$strand,
  methylation = methylation$methylation
)

meth_gr

```


```{r}
mean_region_meth <- function(region, meth_gr, genes_keep, ignore.strand = TRUE) {
  # region: GRanges or GRangesList with names = gene_id

  if (is(region, "GRangesList")) {
    region_sub  <- region[genes_keep]
    region_flat <- unlist(region_sub, use.names = FALSE)
    gene_vec    <- rep(names(region_sub), elementNROWS(region_sub))
  } else if (is(region, "GRanges")) {
    region_flat <- region[genes_keep]
    gene_vec    <- names(region_flat)
  } else {
    stop("region must be GRanges or GRangesList")
  }

  # overlaps between CpGs and the region
  ov <- findOverlaps(meth_gr, region_flat, ignore.strand = ignore.strand)

  # if nothing overlaps, everyone gets 0
  if (length(ov) == 0L) {
    return(setNames(rep(0, length(genes_keep)), genes_keep))
  }

  meth_vals <- mcols(meth_gr)$methylation[queryHits(ov)]
  genes_hit <- gene_vec[subjectHits(ov)]

  # mean methylation per gene
  mean_by_gene <- tapply(meth_vals, genes_hit, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

  # put into a vector aligned to genes_keep, 0 when no CpGs
  out <- setNames(rep(0, length(genes_keep)), genes_keep)
  out[names(mean_by_gene)] <- mean_by_gene
  out
}


```


```{r}
genes_keep <- tail_amp_annotated$gene_id

# for each region type, restrict the gene list to names that actually exist
genes_prom  <- intersect(genes_keep, names(promoters_gene))
genes_exon  <- intersect(genes_keep, names(exons_by_gene))
genes_intr  <- intersect(genes_keep, names(introns_by_gene))
genes_utr5  <- intersect(genes_keep, names(utr5_by_gene))
genes_utr3  <- intersect(genes_keep, names(utr3_by_gene))

# let mean_region_meth() do the subsetting internally
promoter_meth <- mean_region_meth(promoters_gene, meth_gr, genes_prom)
exon_meth     <- mean_region_meth(exons_by_gene,  meth_gr, genes_exon)
intron_meth   <- mean_region_meth(introns_by_gene,meth_gr, genes_intr)
utr5_meth     <- mean_region_meth(utr5_by_gene,   meth_gr, genes_utr5)
utr3_meth     <- mean_region_meth(utr3_by_gene,   meth_gr, genes_utr3)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

meth_cols <- c("meth_promoter","meth_utr5","meth_exon","meth_intron","meth_utr3")
meth_mat <- as.matrix(apply(tail_amp_annotated[,meth_cols],2,as.numeric))

x <- log2(tail_amp_annotated$mean_tail_amputated+1)
rna_scaled <- (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))

combined_mat <- cbind(meth_mat,RNA=rna_scaled)
rownames(combined_mat) <- tail_amp_annotated$gene_id
colnames(combined_mat) <- c("Promoter","5'UTR","Exon","Intron","3'UTR","RNA")

anno_col <- data.frame(Feature=factor(c("Promoter","5'UTR","Exon","Intron","3'UTR","RNA"),
                                      levels=c("Promoter","5'UTR","Exon","Intron","3'UTR","RNA")))
rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(combined_mat)

palette_meth <- colorRampPalette(c("#f7fbff","#deebf7","#c6dbef","#9ecae1","#6baed6",
                                   "#4292c6","#2171b5","#08519c","#08306b"))(100)

anno_colors <- list(Feature=c("Promoter"="#d95f02","5'UTR"="#1b9e77","Exon"="#e6ab02",
                              "Intron"="#66a61e","3'UTR"="#e7298a","RNA"="#7570b3"))

pheatmap(combined_mat,cluster_rows=FALSE,cluster_cols=FALSE,show_rownames=FALSE,
         show_colnames=TRUE,color=palette_meth,breaks=seq(0,1,length.out=101),
         annotation_col=anno_col,annotation_colors=anno_colors,border_color=NA,
         angle_col=0,main="mCG/CG(Methylation) per functional region and RNA (Amputated 1)")


```
